content: Software Developer required skills: Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, SQL, Git, one strong programming language such as Java, Python, or C++, and basic System Design.
Software Developer preparation topics: Arrays, Linked Lists, Trees, Graphs, Dynamic Programming, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks basics.
Data Analyst required skills: SQL, Excel, Python (pandas), data visualization using Power BI or Tableau, and statistics basics.
Data Analyst preparation topics: SQL joins and aggregations, statistical concepts, case-study style business problems, and dashboard building.
AI/ML Engineer required skills: Python, ML fundamentals including regression, classification and evaluation metrics, data preprocessing, basic deep learning, and SQL.
AI/ML Engineer preparation topics: Linear/logistic regression, decision trees, model evaluation using precision, recall and F1, overfitting, and feature engineering.
Frontend Developer required skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React or equivalent framework, responsive design, and Git.
Frontend Developer preparation topics: DOM manipulation, component lifecycle, state management, CSS layout using flexbox/grid, and basic web performance.
